description: This file manages secure storage and retrieval of push relay registration state, including keychain interactions for saving, loading, and clearing registration data and key identifiers. It defines data structures to encode/decode the registration state and provides static functions for persistent storage operations.

classes.name: StoredPushRelayRegistrationState
classes.description: A Codable structure representing the registration state data stored in keychain, includes fields like relayHandle, sendGrant, relayOrigin, etc.

classes.name: PushRelayRegistrationStore
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods to manage push relay registration state, including load, save, and clear operations for registration state and key IDs.

methods.name: loadRegistrationState
methods.description: Loads and decodes registration state from secure keychain storage, returning a RegistrationState instance or nil.

methods.name: saveRegistrationState
methods.description: Encodes and saves a given registration state into secure keychain storage; returns true if successful.

methods.name: clearRegistrationState
methods.description: Deletes stored registration state from keychain.

methods.name: loadAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Retrieves the app attest key ID from keychain, returning nil if not found or empty.

methods.name: saveAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Saves the provided app attest key ID into keychain, returns true if successful.

methods.name: clearAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Deletes the app attest key ID from keychain.

methods.name: loadAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Retrieves the attested key ID from keychain, returning nil if not present or empty.

methods.name: saveAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Saves the provided attested key ID into keychain, returns true if successful.

methods.name: clearAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Deletes the attested key ID from keychain.
